newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Malev signs deal with Air France,Swissair.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Malev signs deal with Air France,Swissair.

text.p: Hungary's national airline Malev Rt has signed deals with Air France and Swissair regarding the Budapest-Paris and Budapest-Zurich routes respectively, Malev said on Friday.
"(Air France and Malev) signed a code-share and block-seat agreement," Malev said in a statement.
It added that both companies will maintain their two daily Budapest-Paris-Budapest flights.
Malev, which operates two daily flights to Zurich, also signed a block-seat agreement with Swissair on March 6, the company said.
It also said that "the two companies will look into finding ways of better serving the Geneva-Budapest traffic."
A Malev official told Reuters the company has suspended its Tirana flights until at least March 18.
